original_ideal_plan.operator_comparison_map: Native operator errors compare unnormalized T_K and T_K^r with U; the accepted maps are T_K/s_K and T_K^r/s_K^r. These are not error bounds for the attenuated accepted maps versus U.

workload.retry_policy: All segments run on every attempt; fresh basis input for every retry
workload.retry_cap_rule: Round p_lower down to 64 dyadic bits, then ceil(log_upper(M/delta_acceptance)/log_lower(1/(1-p_lower))); p_lower=1 uses one attempt

original_ideal_plan.policy: Smallest r enforcing exact binary exposure <=1/2; smallest K<=8 meeting ideal Pauli-bias allocation
original_ideal_plan.guarantee_scope: Any normalized input for ideal exact access at the binary constants, with an exact rational target-exposure correction
original_ideal_plan.implemented_trial_input: Fresh all-zero basis input; it is not a protocol for copying an unknown specimen

bound_source.method: Simulating Hamiltonian Dynamics with a Truncated Taylor Series
bound_source.access: Existing original degree/term PREPARE, signed SELECT and unprepare
bound_source.bound_derivation: Original exact-rational tail, contraction/composition and normalization ledger
bound_source.oaa_identity: One round has block 3F-4FF†F; padding F=T/2 gives 3T/2-TT†T/2

contract.synthesis_contract: If routed accepted-block construction error <= guard and coherent synthesis error <= its allowance, conditional bias <=4 eta/(a-eta) and acceptance >=(a-eta)^2.
contract.guard_scope: The final routed native/OAA accepted block is checked directly, including routing and floating preparation; its numerical guard is an assumption.
contract.no_error_double_counting: Synthesis is one per-attempt mean-bias allocation, not a stochastic failure and not multiplied by accepted slots.

source_access_schedule_metadata.register_order: data, degree, slot0 term, ..., slot(K-1) term
source_access_schedule_metadata.inactive_terms: prepared independently and not selected; their projected weights sum to1
source_access_schedule_metadata.acceptance: all measured degree+word ancillary bits are zero
source_access_schedule_metadata.schedule: run all segments; reset ancillary wires between segments; final Z data readout

physical_profiles.comparison_scope: separate serialized instrument model; not the frozen Grover/PSSPC baseline
assumptions: All complete algorithm attempts run the entire supplied schedule, including rejected trials
Data/workspace logical faults use Litinski's per-patch per-cycle scenario, homogeneously during active/idle/reset operations
Readout uses a majority-of-disjoint-paths independent-error scenario; not an optimized decoder calibration
Residual initialization error has a separately assumed code-distance prefactor in addition to code-volume exposure; it is not inferred from readout or hardware-calibrated
Local Clifford frames are tracked with charged controller work; adjacent CNOT uses three protected Pauli-measurement slots supporting tracked Pauli bases

Tracked Pauli bases, axis orientation at the magic port and protected parity geometry are conditional interface assumptions, not a certified lattice layout; T-dagger adds a charged inverse Clifford-frame decision
Scratch initialization and recycling are charged separately; no favorable overlap is assumed
One factory supplies states just in time; transport uses explicit neighboring logical SWAPs and injection uses CNOT/readout/conditional S plus port reinitialization
QDK native factory output quality is conditional on its model; final logical stages use the declared distance, and compatible handoff is assumed
Factory output quality already incorporates its quantum operations; no duplicate factory-memory fault term is added
Additional output-port residence outside native supply time is charged separately; native factory init/readout timing remains a leading-order macro plus a declared round overhead reserve
Independent complete factory retries use the QDK source-level 1% pipeline failure requirement; up to three feedback delays/decisions are reserved per pipeline
Factory controller decisions are aggregate round-level decisions, not a count of every syndrome bit operation
One trial accept/retry/counter dispatch interval is charged per complete algorithm attempt, and one retry dispatch interval per complete factory attempt
Controller reliability/latency and logical macro geometry are scenario parameters, not measured hardware calibration
Guarded floating synthesis and small instrument checks are numerical evidence, not formal interval certificates
excluded: offline classical coefficient/circuit/synthesis preprocessing and final statistical reporting wall time
measured hardware and decoder throughput validation
unsupported: source-level arbitrary if/else or adaptive quantum feedback; only fixed source schedules plus reset/T-correction and factory/trial dispatch macros are modeled
